description: Convert a Celsius temperature to Fahrenheit with the single direct formula c * 9 / 5 + 32. Pure and deterministic; the floor is one arithmetic expression with no helper, no class, and no indirection (over-abstraction would wrap this one line in pointless structure). The golden arg_sets cover the value-returning domain: the freezing point (0 -> 32), the boiling point (100 -> 212), the fixed point where the scales coincide (-40 -> -40), body temperature (37 -> 98.6), and absolute zero (-273.15 -> -459.67). This is expected to be the smallest injected span in the batch, since the reference is a single expression.
constraints: deterministic, pure, no I/O, no randomness, no global state
